hero.subhead: A tabletop adventure of moral consequence and madness.

about.heading1: A tabletop RPG of high adventure
about.stats: System: Agnostic · Players: 4–6 · Level: 4–6 · Pages: 80 · Format: .pdf
about.system_modal_body: The Rot of Madness is system agnostic — it can be run with any tabletop RPG ruleset. Whether you use D&D 5e, OSR, or your own house rules, the adventure is designed to work alongside your game of choice.
about.heading2: The Rot is a demented madhouse built upon cursed runes. It is filled with disfigured inmates, covered in fog, and concealing arcane secrets.
about.paragraph: The warden of the Rot, an Archmage, has been using a powerful relic to conduct nefarious experiments upon the Rot's inmates.

overview.heading1: The Rot of Madness sets up difficult moral choices and serves as a role-playing challenge for characters of good alignment.
